description: This file contains the implementation of the Opencart Admin Model class 'Theme', responsible for managing CRUD operations related to themes in the OpenCart administrative backend.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Represents the Theme model for managing theme entities within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Inserts a new theme record into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editTheme
methods.description: Updates an existing theme record identified by theme_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Deletes a theme from the database based on theme_id.

methods.name: deleteThemesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all themes associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves a single theme record by theme_id.

methods.name: getThemes
methods.description: Fetches a list of themes with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalThemes
methods.description: Returns the total number of theme records.
